findings.title: Malformed URL terminates server
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap URL construction and return HTTP 400.
findings.why_it_matters: Malformed //% request throws before catches and rejects async HTTP listener.
evidence: Malformed //% request throws before catches and rejects async HTTP listener.

findings.title: Tolerance minimum invalid after rule removal
findings.suggested_fix: Clamp minimum after active group changes; strict does not enforce unused threshold.
findings.why_it_matters: Deleting an active condition leaves minimum above group count, including strict mode.
evidence: Deleting an active condition leaves minimum above group count, including strict mode.

findings.title: Changing source retains obsolete set preview
findings.suggested_fix: Invalidate preview and pending imports when A changes.
findings.why_it_matters: Loading another A retains old preview, allowing old result to overwrite new candidates.
evidence: Loading another A retains old preview, allowing old result to overwrite new candidates.
